items.source: This is Spring's traditional scheduler variant, staying as close as possible to ScheduledExecutorService semantics. Task execution happens on the scheduler thread(s) rather than on separate execution threads. As a consequence, a ScheduledFuture handle (for example, from schedule(Runnable, Instant)) represents the actual completion of the provided task (or series of repeated tasks).
items.translation: 这是 Spring 的传统调度器变体，尽可能贴近 ScheduledExecutorService 语义。任务执行发生在调度器线程上，而不是单独的执行线程上。因此， ScheduledFuture 句柄（例如来自 schedule(Runnable, Instant)） 代表所提供任务（或一系列重复任务）的实际完成。

items.source: Default is false. If set to true, the target executor will be switched into remove-on-cancel mode (if possible).
items.translation: 默认值为 `false`。如果设置为 `true`，目标执行器将切换到取消时移除模式（如果可能）。

items.source: Default is false. If set to true, the target executor will be switched into continuing periodic tasks (if possible).
items.translation: 默认为false。如果设置为true，目标执行器将切换到继续周期性任务（如果可能）。

items.source: Default is true. If set to false, the target executor will be switched into dropping remaining tasks (if possible).
items.translation: 默认值为 `true`。如果设置为 `false`，目标执行器将切换到丢弃剩余任务（如果可能）。

items.source: Note that such a decorator is not being applied to the user-supplied Runnable/Callable but rather to the scheduled execution callback (a wrapper around the user-supplied task).
items.translation: 注意，此类装饰器并非应用于用户提供的 `Runnable` 或 `Callable`，而是应用于调度执行回调（即对用户所提供任务的包装）。

invocation, or to provide some monitoring/statistics for task execution.
